manifest.source_tree_digest_rule: SHA256 of sorted relative FloatLib/**/*.lean path, NUL, file bytes, NUL for every file, including untracked sources.

reproduce.wall_seconds_note: Per-cell elapsed times include both processes, stream IO and concurrent workload. These are correctness-run durations, not a speed comparison between libraries.
